traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Eriocaulaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes basal; plants usually monoecious, rarely dioecious; ovary superior; stems herbaceous; flowers in heads; flowers actinomorphic or zygomorphic; irregular flowers bilabiate; perianth usually sepals and petals, sometimes tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 2 to 3; stamens 2 to 6; carpels 2 to 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 261, 262, family Eriocaulaceae: phyllotaxis pattern spiral (rarely distichous), usually; read as {"spiral": "usually"}.

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 261, 262, family Eriocaulaceae: life span perennial or annual; read as {"annual": "often", "perennial": "often"}.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 261, 262, family Eriocaulaceae: rhizome habit short_creeping (rhizomatous; basal shoots often tufted), usually; read as {"short_creeping": "usually"}.
